newsitem.title: USA: LCI International sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: LCI International sets holder rights plan.

text.p: LCI International Inc on Wednesday said its board of directors approved a shareholder rights plan.

The telecommunications company said in a statement that in connection with the plan's adoption, the board declared a dividend distribution of one preferred stock-purchase right for each outstanding share of common stock.

"Due to the recent volatility in the market in telecommunications stocks, the board felt that it was appropriate at this time to adopt such a plan," said H. Brian Thompson, LCI's chairman and chief executive

Under the plan, the rights would be exercisable only if a person or group purchased 15 percent or more of the common stock, or 20 percent or more in the case of certain purchases by institutional investors.

Each right will entitle shareholders, other than such acquiring person or members of such acquiring group, to buy one one-thousandth of a share of a new series of preferred stock at an exercise price of $100 or to purchase shares of common stock at one-half of their market value.
